text: Franklin Horner Community Centre, 432 Horner Ave., hosts events throughout the year which encourage local residents to come out and meet their neighbours, participate in family oriented events, enjoy musical performances and other activities. The following events are organized by volunteers and board members at Franklin Horner Community Centre. Extravaganza XIII, Saturday September 8 Hometown Fair, Saturday November 17 Breakfast with Santa, Saturday December 15 On behalf of the Franklin Horner Community Centre organizers and volunteers, I request permission for temporary signage to promote the events.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the issuance of a special permit to the Franklin Horner Extravaganza, Hometown Fair, and Breakfast with Santa events to allow the placement of temporary promotional signage at various locations at and around the vicinity of 432 Horner Avenue. 2. Directed that the Franklin Horner Community Centre provide a list of locations to City staff allowing temporary placement of temporary signage in the above-mentioned areas. 3. Directed that the Franklin Horner Community Centre will remove signage within twenty four (24) hours of the event's closure.
